title: Kurwin's Cauteriser

sources.title: Cauteriser
markers: | summary = '''Cauteriser''' is a passive feature that causes the weapon to deal additional fire damage and burn targets.

sources.title: Flourish
markers: | description = Feint an attack to possibly throw your opponent {{SmCond|Off Balance}}.

sources.title: Lacerate

summary: A +1 scimitar that adds 1d4 Fire on a hit and can leave its target Burning.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d6 + 1 Slashing, 5 ft melee. Martial, one-handed, Finesse and Light.
fields.Cauteriser: On hit add 1d4 Fire. A failed DC 13 Constitution save applies Burning for 2 turns, dealing 1d4 Fire per turn. Help, a healing potion, or Wet can end Burning.
fields.Acquisition: Dig up M. Kurwin’s grave and defeat Bugthimble, or use the Nine-Fingers dialogue and pass the extortion Intimidation check. Simply driving the kobold away or burying her loses the blade.
fields.Base value: 65 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Flourish: With proficiency, Bonus Action once per Short Rest. Make a melee weapon attack for 1d4 nonlethal Bludgeoning. A Dexterity save against weapon-action DC +2 prevents Off Balance for 2 turns.
fields.Lacerate: With proficiency, Action once per Short Rest. Make a melee attack for weapon damage. A Constitution save against weapon-action DC +2 prevents Bleeding for 2 turns. The condition source lists Constructs, Elementals, Plants, Oozes and most Undead as immune, with Ghasts and Ghouls as exceptions.
